primary_metric_notes: Ranked Probability Score (lower is better, range [0,1]). Implementation: metrics.ranked_probability_score(). Cumulative probability ordering, divided by 2 per standard 3-outcome RPS convention.

secondary_metric_notes.log_loss: Mean negative log-likelihood. Implementation: metrics.log_loss_multiclass(). Convention: mean over samples of -log(p_c). Lower is better.
secondary_metric_notes.multiclass_brier: Multiclass Brier score. Implementation: calibration._compute_brier_multiclass(). Convention: MEAN over samples of SUM_c(p_c - 1_{y=c})^2. Lower is better.
secondary_metric_notes.accuracy: Overall accuracy from argmax. Implementation: metrics.accuracy_and_per_class().
secondary_metric_notes.ece: Expected Calibration Error, multiclass. Implementation: metrics.expected_calibration_error(). Mean of per-class ECE.

brier_convention.note: MEAN is the authoritative aggregation. Both _compute_brier_multiclass (calibration.py:148) and brier_score_decomposition (metrics.py:52) use MEAN. This resolves the docstring-vs-code discrepancy cited in v2 of the directive.

confidence_intervals.rationale: Non-overlapping block resampling (Kuensch 1989) used instead of iid bootstrap because consecutive football matches within a season share temporal dependence.

baseline_leaderboard_structure.note: Baselines computed on the same chronological holdout set as the candidate. Market-implied baseline uses power-method de-vigged probabilities (connectors/odds_market.py).

policy_notes.brier_gate_status: The specific Brier gate constant 0.220 cited in directive v2 was NOT confirmed in certification_policy.py. Do not apply 0.220 as a gate threshold without re-reading the actual constant.
policy_notes.metric_version_provenance: Every evaluation artifact must include metric_contract_version, git_sha, feature_schema_version, and model_version.
